<documents>
<document id="card-virtual">
VirtualˆcardsˆEveryˆverifiedˆmemberˆcanˆcreateˆoneˆvirtualˆcardˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆItˆworksˆrightˆawayˆforˆonlineˆpurchasesˆandˆinˆmobileˆwallets,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆkeepˆspendingˆwhileˆaˆphysicalˆcardˆisˆonˆitsˆway.ˆ##ˆCreateˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆTapˆCards,ˆthenˆAddˆvirtualˆcard.ˆTheˆcardˆnumber,ˆexpiryˆdateˆandˆsecurityˆcodeˆareˆshownˆinˆtheˆappˆafterˆyouˆconfirmˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆHowˆit'sˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆ-ˆItˆhasˆitsˆownˆcardˆnumber.ˆ-ˆItˆhasˆitsˆownˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆFreezingˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆdoesn'tˆfreezeˆtheˆvirtualˆone.ˆ-ˆItˆcan'tˆbeˆusedˆatˆATMs.ˆ-ˆReportingˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆlostˆorˆstolenˆdoesn'tˆcancelˆtheˆvirtualˆcard.ˆ##ˆReplacingˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆtheˆvirtualˆcardˆnumberˆhasˆbeenˆexposed,ˆdeleteˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆcreateˆaˆnewˆone.ˆThere'sˆnoˆfee.ˆRememberˆtoˆupdateˆanyˆmerchantsˆthatˆstoredˆtheˆoldˆnumber.ˆLimitsˆandˆfeesˆareˆtheˆsameˆasˆforˆyourˆphysicalˆcard,ˆandˆvirtualˆcardˆspendingˆcountsˆtowardˆtheˆsameˆdailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="check-deposit-availability">
WhenˆcheckˆdepositsˆareˆavailableˆOnceˆyourˆcheckˆdepositˆisˆaccepted,ˆhere'sˆwhenˆyouˆcanˆuseˆtheˆmoney.ˆ##ˆStandardˆavailabilityˆ-ˆTheˆfirstˆ$225ˆisˆavailableˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ-ˆTheˆrestˆisˆavailableˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆNewˆaccountsˆForˆaccountsˆopenˆlessˆthanˆ30ˆdays,ˆweˆmayˆholdˆcheckˆdepositsˆforˆupˆtoˆ7ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆLongerˆholdsˆWeˆmayˆalsoˆholdˆaˆcheckˆlongerˆifˆit'sˆunusuallyˆlargeˆforˆyourˆaccount,ˆifˆtheˆcheckˆlooksˆaltered,ˆorˆifˆitˆhasˆbeenˆreturnedˆbefore.ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆreleaseˆdateˆonˆtheˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆReturnedˆchecksˆIfˆtheˆcheckˆbouncesˆafterˆtheˆmoneyˆwasˆmadeˆavailable,ˆweˆtakeˆtheˆamountˆbackˆfromˆyourˆbalance.ˆThere'sˆnoˆreturnedˆitemˆfee.ˆDepositsˆmadeˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆbankˆholidayˆcountˆasˆreceivedˆonˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆCheckˆtheˆstatusˆTapˆtheˆdepositˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆtoˆseeˆwhetherˆit'sˆpending,ˆavailableˆorˆreturned.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="transfers-pending">
Whyˆisˆmyˆtransferˆpending?ˆAˆtransferˆcanˆshowˆasˆpendingˆforˆaˆfewˆreasons.ˆHere'sˆhowˆtoˆtellˆwhat'sˆgoingˆon.ˆ##ˆWaitingˆforˆtheˆcutoffˆACHˆtransfersˆsubmittedˆafterˆ4:00ˆPMˆET,ˆorˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆholiday,ˆstayˆpendingˆuntilˆthey'reˆsentˆonˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆOnˆitsˆwayˆOnceˆsent,ˆACHˆtransfersˆtakeˆ1ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdaysˆtoˆarrive.ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆexpectedˆarrivalˆdateˆonˆtheˆtransfer.ˆ##ˆUnderˆreviewˆSomeˆtransfersˆareˆreviewedˆbeforeˆthey'reˆsent,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆlargeˆfirstˆtransferˆtoˆaˆnewlyˆlinkedˆaccount.ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆ"Inˆreview".ˆReviewsˆusuallyˆfinishˆwithinˆoneˆbusinessˆday,ˆandˆwe'llˆmessageˆyouˆifˆweˆneedˆanything.ˆ##ˆNewˆdeviceˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆtransfersˆaboveˆ$500ˆcan'tˆbeˆsent.ˆ##ˆIncomingˆtransfersˆIfˆmoneyˆsentˆtoˆyouˆhasn'tˆarrived,ˆcheckˆwithˆtheˆsender'sˆbankˆwhenˆitˆwasˆsent.ˆDirectˆdepositsˆusuallyˆarriveˆasˆsoonˆasˆyourˆemployer'sˆpaymentˆfileˆreachesˆus.ˆIfˆaˆtransferˆhasˆbeenˆpendingˆlongerˆthanˆtheˆexpectedˆarrivalˆdate,ˆmessageˆsupportˆwithˆtheˆamountˆandˆdate.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
